technique_name: How can online education help students of low-income families?
description: Online education can help students of low-income families by providing greater access to education at a much lower cost. Online courses and virtual classrooms can be used to bridge the digital divide due to lack of physical access to educational institutions and the lack of financial resources. Online education also allows students to have more flexibility with their studies, since classes can be taken at any time, from any place.
